# copilot-instructions.md
<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This is a Python project. Use industry-standard best practices for structure, formatting, linting, and CI/CD. Use Black for formatting, Ruff for linting (including typing, security, and documentation checks), and ensure all code is type-annotated and documented. Pre-commit hooks must enforce formatting and linting. GitHub Actions should check formatting, linting, and run tests.
